client_tutorial: Join the same LAN or VPN LAN.

Dedicated servers commonly use TCP 25565.
Versions and mods must match.

Use the exact port printed by the host game.
Allow incoming connections for Java/Minecraft in macOS Firewall.

server_install_steps: Open the official Minecraft server download page.

Run it according to Mojang/Minecraft instructions and accept the EULA only if you agree.
